sentences.en: The dancers really came to life during the Latin numbers.
sentences.zh: 拉丁舞曲部分，舞蹈演员们真的活跃起来了。

sentences.en: The dancers spoke a little and only with each other.
sentences.zh: 舞蹈演员们只和彼此说了一点话。

sentences.en: She wrote a book about her life as a dancer.
sentences.zh: 她写了一本书讲述自己作为一名舞蹈演员的生活。

senses.zh: 跳舞者，舞蹈演员,舞女,舞蹈家
